say:1:1035131001:1.text: You overheard? How embarrassing... Darian is my fiance and one of Hogan's soldiers. He's tasked with protecting this town.
say:1:1035131001:1.source_cn: 您听见了，真是不好意思，迪瑞安是我的未婚夫，他是霍根大...
say:1:1035131001:1.male: You overheard? How embarrassing... Darian is my fiance and one of Hogan's soldiers. He's tasked with protecting this town.
say:1:1035131001:1.female: You overheard? How embarrassing... Darian is my fiance and one of Hogan's soldiers. He's tasked with protecting this town.

say:2:1035131002:1.text: Because of the golems, he was sent out two days ago to bring back anyone still hiding in the villages.
say:2:1035131002:1.source_cn: 因为最近魔偶的事，他被派去协调周边居民前来避难，前天刚走。
say:2:1035131002:1.male: Because of the golems, he was sent out two days ago to bring back anyone still hiding in the villages.
say:2:1035131002:1.female: Because of the golems, he was sent out two days ago to bring back anyone still hiding in the villages.

say:3:1035131003:1.text: He's a considerate, hard-working man, but I worry his selflessness will get him in trouble.
